scope: One focused production web UI flow against synthetic snapshot, Monthly, Trends and generated PNG responses. Validates presentation mode changes, source-context values/units/printed limits/page references and read-only Monthly refresh behavior with a controlled browser clock. No real backend, PDF extraction, scanner, archive, Windows or hospital-workstation execution. Date.now/visibility are controlled only in the test browser; real timers and production polling execute normally. Screenshot themes are applied locally for visual inspection. One isolated follow-up HTTP503 Monthly retry case additionally retained the prior model and recovered at the next due interval.
